mapper.sql: id, title, description, cover_url, venue, starts_at, price_cent, total_stock, available_stock, status, publisher_id, published_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO performance (title, description, cover_url, venue, starts_at, price_cent, total_stock, available_stock, status, publisher_id, published_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{coverUrl}, #{venue}, #{startsAt}, #{priceCent}, #{totalStock}, #{availableStock}, #{status}, #{publisherId}, #{publishedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE performance SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, cover_url = #{coverUrl}, venue = #{venue}, starts_at = #{startsAt}, price_cent = #{priceCent}, total_stock = #{totalStock}, available_stock = #{availableStock}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND publisher_id = #{publisherId} AND status = 0 /* 0 = DRAFT，只有草稿可以整体编辑 */
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM performance WHERE status = 1 /* 1 = PUBLISHED */ ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM performance WHERE status = 1 /* 1 = PUBLISHED */

SELECT
FROM performance WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1 /* 1 = PUBLISHED */
